defects_found.title: D3 census exclusion inert: rg options placed after --
defects_found.evidence: v1 selftest F8 FAIL: observed NOT-SAFE(none) ... scratch=yes mtime_age_days=290 (sweep counted the census decoy). Root cause: rg was invoked as `... -- "$name" . -g '!souji-shokunin/census/**' ...`, so after `--` the -g flags and globs became positional paths; rg exits 2 ('-g: No such file or directory') and no exclusion applies. Reproduced standalone.

spec_conformance_notes: O1 calibration risk (spec-prescribed, not a tool defect): when a repo has no refs/remotes/origin/* at all, D1 falls back to local refs/heads/master, so lane-repo files receive SAFE(pushed) from local ancestry alone (observed: census/round-1/census.tsv, default=refs/heads/master). The evidence field discloses the ref used, but 'pushed' here is not remote-publication proof.
O2 `--selftest` with target arguments prints a warning to stderr and ignores the targets; exit code unaffected. CLI grammar in the spec permits paths alongside --selftest.

O3 secrets refusal is a conservative superset of the spec rule (basename match is case-insensitive; a path component literally '.env' also refuses). No read is attempted: short-circuit precedes realpath/stat.

O4 exit 1 on 'evaluation error' is implemented via an internal-error guard (empty verdict or nonzero classify rc -> NOT-SAFE(none, internal-error) and exit 1). Not triggerable by any natural target in this battery; verified by code audit only.
O5 verdict line is exactly 5 tab-separated fields; --json emits one JSON object per target and validates with json.loads.
O6 worktree ordering matches F5/round-1 semantics: named-branch unpushed check precedes the dir-absent unique=0 prune rule.

O7 ~/.config access (judgment call, cross-judge disagreement): evaluate mode leaves git's global config probe enabled, so git opens /home/vgpnk/.config/git/config O_RDONLY on every run (strace-confirmed on the judged sha). There are no writes to ~/.config, no secret-shaped reads, and no forbidden git verbs. I read the rail as 'never write/alter ~/.config'; peer final-62.json (judged sha d32bac5d) read it as 'never access at all' and FAILed on this. Mitigation if the strict reading is adopted: export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null (and set GIT_ATTR/XDG overrides as needed) in evaluate mode as the selftest already does.
